title: Affine ideal tensor sections comparison
statement: Let i : Z → X be a closed immersion, U an affine open of X, R a commutative ring, r : R ≃+* Γ(X,U) a ring isomorphism and I = ker(i.app U ∘ r). There exists an r-semilinear equivalence from I tensor_R (R/I) to Γ((pushforward i).obj ((tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules),U), sending a tensor 1 to the adjunction-unit image of every ideal-module section s with inclusion r(a). The objects and adjunction are those of [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

source.place: Lemma 01R3 (2), affine tensor comparison before the identification I tensor_R R/I = I/I²; Schemes, Lemma 01I9 (1)-(2).

proof.text: For J = i.ker, J.toModules is the kernel of J.toPushforwardSubscheme. The structure modules on X and J.subscheme are quasi-coherent. The pushforward along J.subschemeι is quasi-coherent by isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedImmersion, and isQuasicoherent_kernel proves J.toModules quasi-coherent.

Put A = Γ(X,U), V = i⁻¹U and B = Γ(Z,V). Mathlib gives affineness of V and surjectivity of i.app U directly for the closed immersion. Its kernel on U is i.ker.ideal U by Hom.ker_apply. The ideal inclusion is injective with this range. Thus s ↦ r.symm(inclusion(s)) is an r.symm-semilinear bijection onto I. Invert it to obtain eI : I ≃ₛₗ[r] Γ(i.ker.toModules,U). The first isomorphism theorem for the surjection ρ = i.app U ∘ r gives q : R/I ≃+* B; its formula on quotient representatives proves it is r-semilinear for the A-action on B.

Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to i,U,V and the quasi-coherent ideal module. Rewrite appLE U V le_rfl as app U in both scalar actions. Turn the bijective comparison into a linear equivalence c′ to the pushforward sections on U. Compose TensorProduct.congr eI eB with c′. If inclusion(s)=r(a), injectivity gives eI(a)=s; eB(1)=1 by the ring equivalence. The comparison formula at s tensor 1 now reduces by the identity restriction map and one_smul to the required adjunction unit formula.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_ideal_tensor_sections {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] :
      ∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
        (r : R ≃+* Γ(X, U.1)) (I : Ideal R),
        I = RingHom.ker ((i.app U.1).hom.comp (r : R →+* Γ(X, U.1))) →
        ∃ e : LinearEquiv (r : R →+* Γ(X, U.1))
            (σ' := (r.symm : Γ(X, U.1) →+* R)) (I ⊗[R] (R ⧸ I))
            Γ((pushforward i).obj ((tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules), U.1),
          ∀ (a : I) (s : Γ(i.ker.toModules, U.1)),
            i.ker.toModulesι.app U.1 s = r (a : R) →
            e (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : R ⧸ I)) =
              ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app
                i.ker.toModules).app U.1 s
